The dive track was designed to start just outside the Monument boundary and traversed southward into the Monument up a steep slope. The dive began on a steep sedimented slope to the north of the boundary of Buck Island Reef National Monument at 1812 m. For so much sediment in first half, heading southward into the boundary and upslope, little evidence of wasting or slumping was noted by shore-side geologists.
